correctness.rationale: The joint orthogonal idempotents p_sigma=products of e_h or 1-e_h have diagonal color projections D_sigma. u=sum_sigma p_sigma D_sigma is 1 modulo nilpotent radical J, with u D_sigma=p_sigma u, giving simultaneous conjugation in 1+J over every field, including characteristic 2. The stabilizer of all diagonal projectors is 1+J_same. Unique factorization u=(1+a)b, a in J_diff, b in 1+J_same, follows because J_diff J_same is contained in J_diff; the map a to tuple and nilpotent-series inverse are polynomial, producing actual affine charts. Ranks equal diagonal 1-counts, and coloring weights give the Potts random-cluster q^m Z(2^k,q^-1-1) identity by edge-subset expansion. Positive q-coefficients show degree max 2^k-cut; comparability graph admits proper 2^k coloring exactly when 2^k>=poset height by longest-chain coloring. Independent direct F_2 chain-3 computation enumerated 26 idempotents, 340 commuting ordered k=2 pairs matching 340 color-weight count. Finite case is supplementary.

value.rationale: For every finite poset, an algebraic-geometry classification becomes a closed finite-field multivariate rank distribution whose specialization recovers a standard graph polynomial. This is a motivated, characteristic-uniform, infinite-family enumeration that enables exact calculation and comparison across incidence algebras, not merely the old simultaneous-diagonalization statement. The FK identity and degree threshold give substantive structural interpretations even though graph coloring/FK expansion are standard.

final_claim: For any finite poset and k>=2 pairwise commuting incidence-algebra idempotents, each diagonal 2^k-coloring c has an affine space of dimension d(c)=number of differently colored comparable pairs; finite-field rank enumerator is sum_c q^{d(c)} product_h T_h^{number of 1 bits}, total q^m Z_G(2^k,q^-1-1), with top q-degree m iff 2^k>=height(P).
limitations: Only pairwise-commuting idempotent tuples, k>=2, ordinary representation rank, not general commuting tuples.
Known k=1 idempotent orbit classification and general simultaneous diagonalization are not claimed new.
